selection_rule: eligible candidates ordered lexically by candidate_id; first four fill bpd-pip-ds-01..04; each selected case uses four unique current primary sources allocated one per producer, all four required

eligible_candidates.question: Across the pinned pip sources, give these artifact/metadata literals in order: cache ORIGIN_JSON_NAME, DIRECT_URL_METADATA_NAME, the filename appended by make_pyproject_path(), and WHEEL_EXTENSION.
Across the pinned pip command sources, give the declared defaults in order for: pip list --format, pip cache --format, pip freeze --requirement, and pip inspect --local.
Across the pinned pip command sources, give the normalized usage templates in order for help, hash, search, and show.
Across the pinned pip VCS backend classes, give repo_name in order for Git, Mercurial, Subversion, and Bazaar.

rejected_candidates.reason: All candidate status-code values are defined in one source file, so the answer would not require evidence from at least three producers.
The canonical temporary-directory kind values are defined centrally in temp_dir.py while the build-environment modules mainly reference them, collapsing required answer evidence onto one producer.
The proposed archive-mode and content-type answer is fully available from one source file.
The concrete endpoint values are defined by the PackageIndex source; the search command references that object rather than independently defining enough required evidence.
The complete proposed stdlib package-set answer is contained in one source.
Vendored dependency implementations are not pip-authored primary evidence for this project allocation.
